meta.description: Software developer at Lacuna Software. .NET, Angular and SQL Server for digital signatures and integrations. Experiments with developer tools and AI agents.

text.heroBio: I'm a software developer at Lacuna Software, working with .NET, Angular and SQL Server on digital signature systems. My work covers signature workflows, payments, integrations and performance.
text.workApproach: I like working through a whole solution: understanding the problem, implementing the business rules and making it work well for the people using it. I also explore tools for developing software with AI agents.

bullets: I develop and maintain signature and document management workflows with .NET, Angular and SQL Server, including usability improvements for day-to-day operations.
I implemented a prepaid billing model integrated with a payment gateway, covering business rules and the billing lifecycle.
I build and maintain webhooks for signatures and payments and help customers integrate with ERPs and corporate systems.
I investigate performance issues, fix bugs and improve code in critical parts of the application.
I contribute to architecture decisions, product refinement and feature prioritization, considering business rules and the experience of the people using the software.

toolbox.status: Developer tools · free and open source
toolbox.description: A toolbox for developers, QA and IT professionals: format JSON, decode JWTs, test regular expressions, generate test data and work with files, all in your browser.
toolbox.detail: No account or input uploads to a server. Processing stays local, with catalog search, favorites, recent tools and a Portuguese and English interface.

trama.description: A desktop app for organizing development tasks with AI agents in local Git repositories. It brings agent configuration, worktrees and terminal sessions into one interface.
trama.detail: I explore how to make working with agents easier to follow, from starting a task to tracking its execution. Built with extensive AI assistance; the full diff, commit and merge workflow is still in development.

portfolio.description: This site brings together my professional experience and technical notes on digital signatures and SQL Server, with content in Portuguese and English.
portfolio.detail: It combines technical writing, language navigation, search and components for explaining code and engineering decisions in a static site.
